lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Andrea Zanellato | Lesson 9 -- Welcome Week
lesson.grammar_point: going to for plans and will for decisions, offers and promises

listenings.text: Hi, I'm George, and I'm an HR manager in Manchester. Next month twelve new hires are starting in our company, so we have a plan. On the first day, they are going to meet their mentors and have lunch with the team. On the second day, they are going to learn our systems. On Wednesday, we are going to have a workshop about our values, and on Friday each new hire is going to have a feedback meeting with the manager. And if a new hire has a problem? The mentor will help, and HR will answer on the same day. That is our promise. A good first week is the best way to keep good people.

Hello, my name is Meera, and this is my first week as a payroll analyst. I'm very happy, but there is a lot to learn. My mentor, Laura, is great. We have three goals for my first months. First, I'm going to learn the payroll system in one month. Second, I'm going to meet every manager in the company. Third, I'm going to give a short presentation to the HR team in December. This morning there was an email about an Excel workshop. I thought: I'll sign up now, before I forget. And my manager said: we'll talk about your progress every Friday. I think I'm going to like it here.
